DIVAKAR BARANWAL
 Fund Accounting | Trade Processing | Trade Lifecycle | Investment Operations
 Bengaluru | +91-8906267005 | baranwaldivakar32@gmail.com
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
  Finance professional with 5 years of experience in financial services and investment operations, with exposure to Fund
 Accounting, NAV calculation, trade lifecycle management, reconciliation, corporate actions and investment products across
Equity, Fixed Income, FX and Derivatives.
 Hands-on experience across the end-to-end trade lifecycle: investment decision, trade execution, trade capture,
 confirmation, matching, settlement, reconciliation and client reporting. Experienced in bulk trade uploads and pre-upload
validations.
 Hands-on experience investigating and resolving trade/STP breaks, including security setup gaps and missing or incorrect
 Standing Settlement Instructions (SSI), supporting accurate downstream processing and settlement.
 Experience with Fund Administrator files, investment/accounting data processing, reconciliation controls and SWIFT
 instructions within the trade-processing flow.

  Equity | Fixed Income | FX | Derivatives | Options | Futures | Swaps

  SWIFT Instructions / Transmissions | TLM | Bloomberg | DTCC | Euroclear EasyWay | CAMA | IDC/FTS

TRADE PROCESSING & FUND ACCOUNTING EXPOSURE

 confirmation, matching, settlement, reconciliation and client reporting.
 Performed bulk trade uploads and pre-upload validation, checking trade records for completeness and accuracy before
 system processing to reduce avoidable STP breaks.

 Knowledge of SWIFT instructions/transmissions and their role within the trade lifecycle.
  Knowledge of Equity, Fixed Income, FX, Futures, Options and Swaps.
